thread:
maria_sales: Heads up — ApexCare (enterprise) is asking about a commit. They expect ~10M tokens/month, peak ~800 concurrent chat reqs (short bursts), 95th latency target <=250ms, and HIPAA. They want reserved GPUs with burst credits and an autoscale plan. Can ops/eng/pricing chime in? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1122 :wave:

sam_eng: Quick clarifying Qs — is that 800 active RPS or 800 concurrent requests (avg response ~150 tokens)? also what's the read/write mix (embeddings vs chat)?

maria_sales: It's 800 concurrent chat-ish (users start a session, average prompt+resp ~550 tokens combined). Embeddings are ~10% of traffic (batch). Traffic is spiky: daily peak windows ~20–30min, plus weekly batch jobs at 2am.

eli_sre: For sizing, we need seq-length profile + acceptable tail latency budget. If we assume avg combined tokens=550 and model=babbage-ish open model? do we know model choice?

maria_sales: Customer wants us to host a fine-tuned open LLM (we'll recommend gpt-neoX-20B-quant or similar); they've accepted quantized models. They prefer reserved capacity for predictability + burst credits for occasional peaks.

eli_sre: Ok. Very rough throughput numbers (single A100-ish GPU, gen-only, avg seq ~550): ~110–140 chat RPS depending on quant/kernel. Using conservative 110 RPS: 800 concurrent -> 800/110 ~= 7.3 => round up to 8 reserved GPUs for baseline. Add a 50% burst buffer for 30min windows => +4 GPUs (burst pool) so plan = 8 reserved + 4 burst credits (or autoscale up to 12 with caps). Recommend AZ spread 2 AZs, spot tolerance yes but no more than 25% of reserved. KV cache warmup required to hit tail SLOs.

sam_eng: Suggested autoscale policy (can feed to Dedicated config):
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 8,
  "max_replicas": 12,
  "scale_metric": "rps",
  "target_rps_per_replica": 110,
  "scale_cooldown_secs": 60,
  "burst_policy": {
    "burst_credits": 4,
    "credit_recharge_rate_per_min": 1
  }
}
```

pricing_bot: Need a cost ballpark to include in SOW. Provide reserved vs on-demand monthly delta.

sam_eng: Back-of-envelope: if reserved A100-equivalent is $7,200 / GPU-month (committed rate) -> 8 * $7,200 = $57,600/mo baseline. Burst capacity (4 GPUs) on reserved-burst credits priced at 40% of committed rate when used -> estimated additional (if used 10% of month) ~ 4 * $7,200 * 0.4 * 0.1 = ~$1,152. Ops & infra margin + observability + support add ~15% => rough monthly recurring = ~$66k. On-demand equivalent (no commit) for same peak capacity would be materially higher during peaks. Note: final pricing should come from finance/pricing.

tara_se: Security checklist items flagged by ApexCare: HIPAA BAAs, KMS integration for envelope encryption, customer-managed keys (CMK), audit logs retention 1 year, quarterly pen-test report. Can we confirm Private deployment options?

maria_sales: Yes — propose Private (VPC) with CMK + SOC2 docs + audit log export. I'll attach the security questionnaire answers.

eli_sre: Operational notes to hit 95th<250ms:
- KV cache TTL=6h, prewarm on deploy and before peak windows.
- Warmup job: replay 2% of production traffic (synthetic) 45 minutes before expected peaks.
- Prefer canary rollouts with 10% traffic for first 15 minutes.
- Circuit-breaker: if tail latency >500ms for 3m, failover to cheaper, lower-capacity model.

ops_bot: [deploy-bot] created preheat-runbook ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OP-7789 (assigned to @eli_sre).

sam_eng: Also adding a short smoke test script for ops (paste into runbook):
```bash
# smoke.sh - kv warm + small load
python tools/smoke_load.py --model apexcare-prod --rps 50 --duration 600
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat -d '{"model":"apexcare-prod","kb":true}'
```

maria_sales: Next steps — I'll put 8x reserved + 4x burst in initial SOW draft, include cost ballpark, and run security questionnaire answers by Legal. Can pricing team draft final quote? :+1:

pricing_bot: On it — I'll draft two SKU lines (Reserved 12-month commit with burst credits, and an on-demand comparison) and drop in the deal doc by EOD.

eli_sre: I'll scope the prewarm + canary runbook and outline AZ placement. tagging @tara_se for security signoff once legal answers are in.

maria_sales: Great — closing this thread. I'll schedule a short sync with ApexCare for Thurs 9am PT to agree on pilot cadence. Thanks everyone :rocket:
